evidence.name: Screen field: Editable content for your HTML
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Editable content for your HTML" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Editable content for your HTML
sections.description: Adds reusable pieces of content (text, images, and more) that your custom HTML can read by name, so copy and visuals live in the editor instead of being hard-coded. In code you fetch one by its name, which lets you or a non-developer update content later without touching the HTML. The Image URL Scanner can auto-create media sources from external image links it finds, so those images get hosted and tracked by Segmently.
